findings.text: follow-on: the six analytic certificate rows (test_analytic_certificate_moments, parametrized limited/diverted x 550/2000/5000) read os.environ["NOVA_BOOK_RESULTS"] and os.environ["NOVA_BOOK_CACHE"] directly and call scripts.prototypes.support.book.measure, so with those variables unset the node's headline acceptance row raises KeyError rather than skipping or failing a named clause. The rows are heavy by construction (H200, 17:24 wall in certificate-resumed.log) and the node carried the receipt through an external script, so this is not a defect in the change; it is the reason the acceptance clause is not exercisable in the default CPU lane. A skip-with-reason guard would make the row's absence visible.

follow-on: the reviewed node's done-when (3) holds every read-driven booking image error at or below the exact-support arm's, but the limited-553 rung does not meet that literally (read 1.777778665e-05 against exact 1.211317518e-05). The node stopped and asked (NEEDS-HELP in lane-change-2-final.txt), and the coordinator supplied a resume ruling (resume-1-advice.txt) relaxing the limited case to read <= 2*exact + oracle uncertainty and <= 1e-4 absolute; under that ruling all six rows pass. The relaxation is a real change to the node's acceptance and is recorded only in the run directory, not in the plan; the plan's §3 done-when should carry it so a later reader reconciles the row without the run's advice file.

follow-on: the published figure booking-image-error.svg is a three-rung comparison (read, exact, legacy) but the read arm's limited rungs pass only under the resumed ruling above, which the figure's caption-level context should name so a reader does not read the read arm as strictly dominating the exact arm at every rung. Cosmetic to the change; named for the coordinator's writeback.

justifications.durability: The clause that matters most — private-flux cells booking zero — is genuinely falsifiable and I reproduced the failure myself: with NOVA_BOOK_LEVEL_MEMBERSHIP=1 the reviewed head prints PRIVATE_FLUX_CURRENT=1.6000000000000001 and test_private_fragment_current_is_zero fails, EXIT=1 (review-negcontrol.log). The differentiation contract is held by test_booking_jvp_matches_central_difference at a strict 1e-10 (smooth) / 1e-8 (others) on the final step, and test_fragment_capacity_is_refused holds the capacity refusal. The gap that keeps this below the top band is that the headline analytic acceptance row is env-gated: with NOVA_BOOK_RESULTS/NOVA_BOOK_CACHE unset it raises KeyError instead of running, so nothing in the default lane asserts the certificate clauses.
justifications.evidence: Independently reproduced rather than read: the reviewed head 95a2e2460 in its own worktree gives 8 passed, EXIT=0 for the focused gate (review-head.log), and the declared negative control re-run under the mutation gives 1 failed, EXIT=1 (review-negcontrol.log). The heavy certificate arm is read from the run's own logs: certificate-resumed.log reports 5 passed in 1044.09s on H200 job 1283223 including the asserted legacy diverted 550 control, and certificate-acceptance.log accepts all six rows with max_net_current_relative_error 2.220446049250313e-16 and excluded_current 0.0. The one provenance caveat is that the aggregate suite logs had their header lines reconstructed after the fact (asdelivered companions preserved); the failure content is unchanged.
justifications.fit: Extends the owners the plan names rather than adding a parallel path: book() calls the same clipped_support_current_moments and, as the brief explicitly required, widens the one-polygon-per-cell contract in clip_quadrature.py (a 4-D ring bank and a signed option) instead of writing a second booker. It reuses topology.quadratic_cell_fragments, topology._positive_vertical_intervals, topology._cubic_parameters and saddle_normal_form, and FluxFieldPolynomial. The module is new and holds current.book as §3 assigns; it is intentionally not yet on the solve path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All six §3 clauses and the followup's booking clause are met at the reviewed head. The diverted read-driven booking error is at or below the exact-support arm at all three rungs, the private-flux region books zero by construction, the net current matches the analytic total to 2.2e-16, the JVP matches central differences at the four existing stages, and the negative control fires. The limited-553 rung meets clause (3) only through the coordinator's resumed ruling (recorded as a follow-on), which is a relaxation the node asked for and did not grant itself — the correct handling, but a clause a later reader cannot reconstruct from the plan alone.
justifications.reuse: Reuses the existing quadrature kernels (_quadrature_from_arrays, _integrate_current_polynomial, _integrate_current_points) and the topology read's fragment machinery; the only additions to clip_quadrature.py are a signed flag on the existing array quadrature and a ring-reduction wrapper, so the signed-ring integration shares the polygon kernels rather than re-deriving them. Quadrature and FragmentSupport are new dataclasses scoped to the booking, not a duplicated mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: Eight files changed across nine commits, every one inside the declared write paths; the diffstat reconciles at 8 files, 3473 insertions / 42 deletions. The three files the brief fences off to concurrent nodes (nova/equilibrium/forward.py, forward_operator.py, topology.py) are untouched, and wiring the book onto the solve path is correctly left to a later node.
